explanation_en: Recommended: Supplier credit — Shaoxing Huaxin (60 days), total cost USD 31.20 over 60 days.
explanation_bn: প্রস্তাবিত: Supplier credit — Shaoxing Huaxin (৬০ days), ৬০ দিনে মোট খরচ USD ৩১.২০।

options.name: Supplier credit — Shaoxing Huaxin (60 days)
options.conditions: 0% interest, but goods are priced 2% higher; pay 60 days after shipment.

options.name: Escrow-backed order loan — Setu Partner Finance (Lender B)
options.collateral: Assignment of the funded escrow tranches
options.conditions: 9.0% p.a., USD 40 flat fee, repaid when milestone 3 is released.

options.name: Working-capital line — Shitalakshya Capital (NBFI)
options.conditions: 14% p.a. on the drawn amount, 30 to 120 days, no invoice needed.

options.name: Export-credit-insured supplier terms — Silk Route Cover
options.conditions: Supplier ships on 90-day open account; about 1.2% flat cost passed on.

why_not.en: Open-account insured terms replace escrow; not offered once escrow is funded
why_not.bn: ইনস্যুরড ওপেন-অ্যাকাউন্ট শর্ত এসক্রোর বিকল্প; এসক্রো অর্থায়িত হলে প্রযোজ্য নয়

options.name: Import loan — Meghna Commercial Bank (Lender A)
options.collateral: Lien on imported goods + post-dated cheque
options.conditions: 11.5% p.a., 0.5% processing fee, 90-day tenor, minimum USD 2,000.

why_not.en: Amount must be at least USD 2000.00

reasons.en: Recommended: Supplier credit — Shaoxing Huaxin (60 days), total cost USD 31.20 over 60 days.

reasons.bn: যোগ্য বিকল্পগুলোর মধ্যে মোট খরচ সবচেয়ে কম।
